events.title: Sliced inverse regression · Dr. Ker-Chau Li
events.summary: At the ASA Nevada Chapter Fall Symposium, I attended Dr. Ker-Chau Li’s discussion of sliced inverse regression (SIR): reducing many predictors to a few informative combinations that retain information about an outcome. The talk deepened my interest in dimension reduction for biomedical research.
events.details: Related paper: Li, K.-C. (1991). Sliced Inverse Regression for Dimension Reduction. Journal of the American Statistical Association, 86(414), 316–327.

events.title: Liquid association · Dr. Ker-Chau Li
events.summary: I attended Dr. Ker-Chau Li’s talk on liquid association at the UNLV Department of Mathematical Sciences Statistics Seminar. Liquid association explores how the relationship between two variables changes with a third variable, with applications to gene coexpression and biomedical research.
events.details: Related paper: Li, K.-C. (2002). Genome-wide coexpression dynamics: Theory and application. PNAS, 99(26), 16875–16880.
